name: MCP Conformance Receipt
promise: One vendor-neutral MCP endpoint run with a shareable exact-evidence JSON receipt and an offline verification receipt.
buyer: Anyone shipping, buying, or debugging an MCP server or carrier integration.

deliverables: required-tool parity with exact missing set
request, response, input, and final receipt SHA-256 values
public-safe endpoint label with URL credentials omitted
offline verification receipt for canonical integrity, privacy, discovery-ledger, parity, and status invariants
tiers.target_delivery: same session after a reachable public endpoint is supplied
same day after a reproducible failure and writable repository are supplied

runner.optional_mode: caller-explicit arbitrary tools/call with response body hashed by default
runner.verification_mode: offline strict-JSON and semantic verification; no endpoint access

public_fields: public repository URL if repair is requested
intake.private_values: Keep credentials, tokens, private repositories, buyer records, and provider data outside public Commons receipts.

payment.claim: A posted intent, quote, recorded URL, report, or verification receipt is not payment, settlement, payout, bank availability, or cash.
payment.external_requirement: A chargeable hosted-provider checkout for this exact SKU must be created and verified in the provider before the page may call it active.

acceptance: receipt JSON parses and carries schema commons-mcp-conformance-receipt-v1
endpoint label omits URL userinfo, query, and fragment
transport and discovery outcomes are explicit
successful response transport rows record exact byte length and SHA-256; failure rows preserve only response hash metadata the runner actually emits
the final receipt SHA-256 recomputes from canonical unsigned JSON
the offline verifier accepts the delivered receipt without endpoint access and emits schema commons-mcp-conformance-verification-v1 with valid=true and its own verification_sha256
